description: Put them on the lane, and kept dinner from becoming a speech.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Left the sword on the nail, and said so once.
name: Hamnet Shakespeare

description: Applied the rule about not looking, and tested whether a short grace still counted.
name: Judith Shakespeare

description: Said the sentence once, and said she had finished.
name: Mary Shakespeare

description: Found her place in the book, and said she had not turned.
name: Susanna Shakespeare

description: Answered with Friday's letter, and gave his arm.
name: William Shakespeare
